This work aims to provide respective asset or system value at risk, highlighting RiskRecon’s research and development in automated cyber risk assessment and security monitoring.

overview_description.description: RiskRecon is the only continuous vendor monitoring solution that delivers risk-prioritized action plans custom-tuned to match your risk priorities, providing the world’s easiest path to understanding and acting on third-party cyber risk. Partner with RiskRecon to build your scalable, third-party risk management program to realize dramatically better risk outcomes. To learn more about RiskRecon’s approach, request a demo or visit the website at www.riskrecon.com.

product.name: RiskRecon Cyber Ratings
product.description: A platform that provides continuous, automated cyber risk ratings for third-party vendors based on their externally visible security posture.

product.name: RiskRecon Privacy Ratings
product.description: A service that evaluates third-party vendors' privacy practices and compliance through automated privacy risk ratings.

product.name: RiskRecon Assessments
product.description: Automated cyber risk assessments that provide detailed, prioritized action plans based on vendor security performance and asset value.

product.name: Threat Protection by Mastercard
product.description: A service that offers cyber threat protection and business continuity support by monitoring and mitigating cyber threats.

product.name: Cyber Quant by Mastercard
product.description: A cyber risk quantification tool that translates cyber risk into financial terms to support risk management decisions.

product.name: Systemic Risk Assessment
product.description: An assessment service that evaluates cyber risk across an organization's entire supply chain, including fourth-party dependencies.
